changes: Persistent early/entry queue cursors preserve missing outcomes without starving later work
Verified raw collector history uses indexed generation/bucket/shard range and a truncation sentinel
Scan fallback uses indexed ts_bucket and preserves twenty-minute sampled semantics
Budget admission before subsequent statements; original caps retained
Durable queue turn independent of hourly maintenance or admission delays
Statistical budget pause cannot cancel an otherwise complete manual report

live_statistics.scope: Measured individual accepted invocations, not a guarantee of every future query cost; unindexed entry/readiness aggregates remain a growth-risk item.

owner_execution_policy.test_policy: One integrated verification after the complete change block; rerun only for a specific failed case, newly discovered integration defect, or release acceptance.
owner_execution_policy.percentage_policy: Withdraw unmeasured 60-percent estimate; report requirement evidence and remaining constraints instead.

progress_estimate.method: Evidence-linked requirement ledger; no invented denominator or percentage.

statistical_processing_policy: Alternate queues on admitted hourly low-priority invocations; capture remains each admitted invocation. No fixed forty-minute claim.
remaining: Per-field strongest verified source assignment and equivalent fallbacks across all blocks
Inherited source-clock provenance and unmet N-block factual coverage
Independent source/volume utility and T16.5 sample
Longitudinal cost and throughput of entry/readiness aggregates; pre-admission is not engine hard row cap
do_not_repeat_without_new_evidence: PR18-30 provider surveys and accepted defect controls
Already diagnosed oldest-task starvation as new research
Volume-profile research before new comparable data
